clause: Batch stack utilities: load-into-stack, statistics, contact-sheet family, watched-folder [STU-AUT-013]

scope.summary: Implement the deduped stack/utility batch capabilities on the one runner: load files into one document as layers with optional auto-align/stacking; stack statistics render (mean/median/max/min/range/std-dev/summation modes); utility batches (contact-sheet, multi-page presentation, fit-to-size, split-scanned-images, panorama-merge); watched-folder asset export (continuously export assets from layers whose names carry export directives on change).
expected_tests: live: load-files-into-stack builds one layered document
test: stack statistics median render correct
live: watched-folder export emits assets on layer-name directive change

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Stack, statistics & utility batches (model layer)

Corrected: the external watcher exists in the WP-KERNEL-012 base today, at src/frontend/palmistry. The earlier reason assumed it shipped later.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-AUT-013] The batch surface MUST cover the deduped capabilities below as ONE runner with options, not as separate tools. A source suite's separate batch/droplet/image-processor/statistics/stack utilities collapse into one batch job type parameterized by source set, applied command sequence, output format set, and post-processing options. | Batch capability | Behavior | Deduped source provenance | |---|---|---| | Batch-apply over a folder/set | Run a macro or command sequence across an input file set with override-open, suppress-dialogs, destination, filename template, and error log | Batch dialog; batch jobs | | Portable batch action ("droplet" equivalent) | Export a batch job as a portable, re-runnable job artifact that processes a dropped/passed file set | droplets | | Format-conversion batch ("image-processor" equivalent) | Batch-convert a folder to target formats with resize and profile conversion, with or without a prior recorded macro | Image Processor | | Multi-format output | Emit one or more output formats per source in a single pass | batch-job multi-format output | | Load set into one document | Load multiple files as layers of one document with optional auto-align and stacking | Load Files into Stack | | Stack statistics render | Render a layer stack through statistical modes (mean, median, max, min, range, standard deviation, summation, and related) | Statistics stack modes | | Utility batches | Contact-sheet, multi-page presentation, fit-to-size, split-scanned-images, and panorama-merge utilities as batch operations | Contact Sheet / PDF Presentation / Fit Image / Crop-and-Straighten / Photomerge | | Watched-folder asset export | Continuously export assets from layers whose names carry export directives on change | Generate Image Assets | ### 5. Variables, data sets, and data-driven graphics (data merge)

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
